get.description:
A champion as plain numbers a game core can be built from (`evolve.networks.compiled`): a layered
network's weights, or a NEAT genome's compiled evaluation plan. What the browser feeds the Rust
`CheckersStrategy` -- so no client re-implements NEAT or the weight layout.

schema.title: Response Get Brain Runs  Run Id  Artifacts  Ref  Brain Get

post.description:
Package any stored champion on demand -- how the browser watches a champion that was never
published (a still-training run's latest, a pinned generation). Development/live-training only:
it costs a little server compute per *new* champion, never per frame, and packages are
content-addressed, so asking again for the same champion re-uses the stored one. Unlike
publisher.models it measures only numeric parity (on random inputs), not action agreement
on the protocol's games -- so it's marked `on_demand`, and never becomes a leaderboard entrant.

schema.title: Response Export Champion Runs  Run Id  Artifacts  Ref  Package Post

post.description: Appends generations in order. Each must belong to this run: a mismatched id is a client bug, not data.
